[RDSC.7.2] "exactly 1" means the compiler must write exactly one such
atom. The runtime must reject a file with none, and does not check for a
second: every multiplicity of [RDSC.7.1] is the compiler's guarantee, which
the runtime does not re-check ([RDSC.9.9]). An
artefact that did not come from a conforming compiler carries none of them.
